mapper.sql: FROM run_items i JOIN requests r ON r.id=i.request_id JOIN accounts a ON a.id=r.account_id WHERE i.status IN('queued','running')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_items WHERE status IN('queued','running')
SELECT a.platform_id FROM requests r JOIN accounts a ON a.id=r.account_id WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT r.* FROM requests r JOIN accounts a ON a.id=r.account_id WHERE a.platform_id=#{platformId} AND a.enabled=1 AND r.enabled=1 AND r.id=#{requestId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_items i WHERE i.request_id=r.id AND i.status IN('queued','running')) ORDER BY a.sort_order,a.rowid,r.sort_order,r.rowid
SELECT * FROM run_batches WHERE status='queued' ORDER BY created_at,rowid LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE run_batches SET status='running' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='queued' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_batches other WHERE other.platform_id=run_batches.platform_id AND other.status='running')
UPDATE run_items SET status=#{status},safe_summary=#{summary},finished_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='queued'
UPDATE run_items SET status='running',started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='queued'
UPDATE run_items SET status=#{status},http_status=#{httpStatus,jdbcType=INTEGER},duration_ms=#{durationMs},safe_summary=#{summary},finished_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='running'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_completions(request_id,business_date,completed_run_id) VALUES(#{requestId},#{date},#{runId}) ON CONFLICT(request_id,business_date) DO UPDATE SET completed_run_id=excluded.completed_run_id

INSERT INTO request_day_states(request_id,business_date,unknown_pending) VALUES(#{requestId},#{date},#{pending}) ON CONFLICT(request_id,business_date) DO UPDATE SET unknown_pending=excluded.unknown_pending
mapper.update: UPDATE requests SET auth_paused=1,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{requestId} AND current_revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO request_day_states(request_id,business_date,unknown_pending) SELECT i.request_id,b.business_date,1 FROM run_items i JOIN run_batches b ON b.id=i.batch_id WHERE i.status='running' ON CONFLICT(request_id,business_date) DO UPDATE SET unknown_pending=1
mapper.update: UPDATE run_items SET status='unknown',safe_summary='服务上次中断，发送结果待确认',finished_at=#{now} WHERE status='running'
UPDATE run_batches SET status='queued' WHERE status='running'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO request_day_states(request_id,business_date,unknown_pending) SELECT i.request_id,b.business_date,1 FROM run_items i JOIN run_batches b ON b.id=i.batch_id WHERE i.batch_id=#{batchId} AND i.status='running' ON CONFLICT(request_id,business_date) DO UPDATE SET unknown_pending=1
mapper.update: UPDATE run_items SET status='unknown',safe_summary='执行过程异常，结果待确认',finished_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status='running'

UPDATE run_batches SET status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_items i WHERE i.batch_id=run_batches.id AND i.status='queued') THEN 'queued' ELSE 'completed' END WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN('queued','running')
UPDATE run_batches SET cancel_requested=1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE run_items SET status='cancelled',safe_summary='取消剩余队列',finished_at=#{now} WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND status='queued'
UPDATE run_batches SET status='completed' WHERE id=#{id} AND status='queued'
